about: The one place a check of the scene checker (npm run check:scenes; plan file 18, section 4.6) may be excused.
Each entry names one check (a stage id), one scene, one match and a reason, and holds Brian's dated words.

match is text that must be in the piece's name exactly as the report prints it: what the game calls the mesh, a colon, the code that built it; for a piece inside something a mesh sets down, thing "name": goes in front.

An entry excuses nothing it does not match, and what it excuses is still listed by name and counted: the count is a ratchet (scenes.connect.excused in RATCHETS.json) that may only fall, so an entry can never come to cover a new piece.

status "pending" marks an entry Brian has not answered: its date and words are null. The two below are the old tool's two exemptions (tools/floatingVoxels.ts), moved here in milestone 0. No pending entry may be added later; a new entry needs Brian's words in the pull request, and the number of entries (scenes.exemptions in RATCHETS.json) may only fall.

exemptions.reason: The low hills behind the barn and the far mountain range stand apart from the yard's ground: there is open air between the yard and the hills, and between the far hills and the range. The old tool excused everything built by buildDistance.

The alarm clock on the nightstand is set down by its mesh, and is not one piece: its face stands one cell in front of its drum, its two feet touch the drum only at a corner, and the ring lines it throws when it goes off hang in the air beside it. The old tool excused every bedroom part placed by a mesh.
